explication: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents. An agent reaches either the OpenClaw or MCP adapter, whose canonical tool contracts dispatch REST requests to the server. The server authenticates requests, creates isolated sessions and tabs, launches Camoufox, then returns snapshots, refs, screenshots, extracted data, downloads, or interaction results. Important secondary stages include cookie and storage persistence, search and media macros, VNC login, tracing, and crash telemetry. Some route wiring is unsampled, so optional links are shown conservatively.
